name: sweatpants
description: AI Chat Framework - Build interactive chat applications with streaming, tools, and durable sessions

scripts.dev:yo-chat: pnpm -C packages/framework dev --watch & DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_PROVIDER=${DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_PROVIDER:-github-copilot} DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_ID=${DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_ID:-gpt-5.5} pnpm -C apps/yo-chat dev
scripts.dev:yo-chat:local: pnpm -C packages/framework dev --watch & DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_PROVIDER=${DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_PROVIDER:-ollama} DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_ID=${DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_ID:-gemma4:12b-mlx} MCP_TOOL_RUNTIME=local pnpm -C apps/yo-chat dev
scripts.dev:yo-chat:agentcore: pnpm -C packages/framework dev --watch & DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_PROVIDER=${DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_PROVIDER:-amazon-bedrock} DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_ID=${DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_ID:-zai.glm-5} AWS_REGION=${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1} MCP_TOOL_RUNTIME=agentcore pnpm -C apps/yo-chat dev
scripts.build: pnpm run -r build && pnpm validate:exports && pnpm validate:product-surface
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm -C apps/yo-chat test:e2e && pnpm -C apps/yo-mcp test
scripts.pull:gemini-cli: rm -rf apps/yo-agent/packages/gemini-cli && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli.git apps/yo-agent/packages/gemini-cli && rm -rf apps/yo-agent/packages/gemini-cli/.git
